description: 2nd connection - re-tests F0805A (fixed after the 1st connection's RNF7064 DTAARA(*LDA) syntax error, docs/probes.md) and adds the FIRST-EVER compile+run of Q0805B (solutions/08-05/q0805bs.sqlrpgle, the embedded-SQL 2-cursor rewrite of ZA0500's M1/MR processing). Self-contained, same convention as the 1st connection: recompiles JU0300 AND the 05-13-ticket-fixed ZA0500/JU0900C pair (solutions/05-13/za0500-ticket3.rpg + ju0900c-ticket1.clp, the SAME pair part08-05-legacy-baseline used) in this SAME connection, so all FOUR programs' printed output can be diffed against each other and against verify/part08-05-legacy-baseline/expected/golden-master.md from this one connection's own 'run' section text. Q0805B is called DIRECTLY (CALL PGM(&LIB/Q0805B) PARM('*TEST' 5)), not through JU0900C - unlike the original ZA0500 (which depends on JU0900C's own OVRDBF SHARE(*YES) to see JUCHUD at all), Q0805B opens its own SQL cursors on JUCHUD/JUCHUM independently, so it needs no caller-provided file override and no JU0900C involvement to run standalone with the same RMODE/MINQTY JU0900C would have passed. RUNTXRESET first (same reasoning as every other part08-05* manifest: shared library, need the true seed state). Every CRTxxxPGM step DLTPGM-then-REPLACE(*YES) (same reasoning: a compile failure leaves the object MISSING, not stale). *LDA FTOK cleared to blank before JU0300/F0805A (unrelated to ZA0500/Q0805B, which use *LDA for nothing). RMODE stays '*TEST' throughout (ZA0500/Q0805B both) so ZAIKOM is never mutated - no TXRESET needed afterward either. No collect steps: every program's own printed QSYSPRT text is read directly from the connection's own 'run' section (part06-0103-freeform's confirmed finding), diffed by hand afterward, same as the 1st connection.

steps.label: CPJU03
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPF0805A
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0805A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/F0805A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(F0805A) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZA05
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(ZA0500) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJU09
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPQ0805B
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/Q0805B)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0805B) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0805B) OBJTYPE(*PGM) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) COMMIT(*NONE)
